title: docs(releases): expand v15 page to full 14.8→15.0→15.1 backend + Console coverage
body:
Follow-up to #3079 (merged): the first curated pass under-covered the v15 line in three structural ways, called out in release review. This expands `content/docs/releases/v15.mdx` from ~465 to ~1010 lines:

## 1. 15.0.0 backend was missing everything outside ADR-0095

From the `14.8.0..15.0.0` range (23 commits), now added:
- **BREAKING — strict view/page schemas** (ADR-0089 D3a, #2943): `FormFieldSchema`/`FormSectionSchema`/`PageComponentSchema` are `.strict()`; mis-layered/typo'd visibility keys are loud parse errors, with migration guidance. This was a real spec-15.0.0 breaking change absent from the page.
- **Behavior changes:** per-row import automation chain + `skipAutomations` + REST import `runAutomations` default ON (#2922); `sys_position`/`sys_capability` system-row write guardrail (#2930); bidirectional visibility-root lint (#2931); explain posture-label alignment (#2949).

## 2. 15.0.0 had no Console section at all

15.0.0 bundled the **objectui 14.0 major** (13.2.0 → 14.0.0, ~73 commits) — never disclosed on any release page (much of it rode unversioned in the 14.8.0 pin). New section covers:
- ADR-0057 ChatDock consolidation, **including its breaking cleanup** (#2475: `features.chatDock` removed, `ConsoleFloatingChatbot`/`StudioAiCopilot` deleted, sessions re-keyed to `(user, app, product)`), with migrations
- The Gantt batch (API datasource write-back, dependency validation, lock loop), lists/grids, sharing-rule form pickers, phone sign-in, Studio deep links, i18n, and two security fixes (chat-cache clearing on logout #2485, MetadataClient Bearer auth #2410)
- The six early-14.1 commits the 15.0.0 pin picked up (record-grained explain panel, provenance badges, AI usage indicator…)

## 3. 15.1.0 sections were over-compressed

Every domain expanded to full changeset detail; the Console 14.1 section now covers all eight areas of the 94-commit range (record inline-edit line, CEL editor family, dashboard filters, Access pillar, flow designer, kanban, Studio misc, fixes) instead of seven bullets.

## Checks

- `check:release-notes` OK
- `check:role-word` OK (rebased over #3081; the two new generic-English "role" usages reworded — ADR-0090 D3 ratchet)
- Facts sourced from consumed changesets + commit bodies on both repos (framework `14.8.0..15.1-pending`, objectui `13.2.0..b8967495`), assembled via two range-analysis passes
